summary: Iteration 11 QA covering CR-082 (requires_customer flag), CR-106 (channel filter), CR-109 (strip/upper), plus full coupon regression. All items PASS.

PHASE_A_CR082.details: V1–V6, V10, V11 all pass. Generic coupon (requires_customer=false) validates without customer_id. Standard coupon (requires_customer=true) returns CUSTOMER_REQUIRED when no customer_id. Available coupons endpoint correctly filters by requires_customer. Usage recorded for generic coupon.

PHASE_A2_CR082_regression.details: cr001c (4 tests) + cr021 (3 tests) — backward compat confirmed. requires_customer defaults to True. PUT update to false persists correctly. Validation with customer_id never triggers CUSTOMER_REQUIRED.

PHASE_A3_CR082_frontend.details: requires-customer-toggle visible with correct data-testid. Default checked=True (standard). Uncheck → aria-checked=false (generic). Generic badge code verified in CouponsPage.jsx line 544 with data-testid='generic-badge-{id}'. Toggle is PASS on desktop 1920px.

PHASE_B_CR106.details: V1: dine_in=24. V2: delivery=23 (≤ dine_in). V3: no-param excludes pos-only, all consumer channels present. V4: takeaway==delivery (23). V5: SKIP (no pos+dine_in coupon in r689 prod). V6: all dine_in results have 'dine_in' in applicable_channels.

PHASE_C_CR109.details: V1-V3: leading/trailing spaces stripped on create (CRM + POS routes). V4: dup check fires on stripped code. V5: 0 DB docs with leading/trailing spaces. Internal spaces ('FLAT TODAY') preserved correctly.

PHASE_D_combined_regression.details: GET /scan/coupons (no channel) returns coupons (BUG-034 still fixed). FLAT100TEST validates valid:true (CR-105 regression ok). Staff coupon list → 200 (no schema regression from CR-082).
